disputes.issue: With a 5-month ramp-up (E9) and departures running April-September, an analyzer could argue backfills would not have reached the rotation by 2026-09-30 anyway, so the freeze's causal effect on frequency within the observed window was not clearly established; the original rationale's claim that 'no rival explanation remains' was overstated.
disputes.resolution: Kept 'causal'. Reworded E9 to state the two cancelled offer-stage hires had 2026-03-02 start dates and would have joined the rotation after ramp-up in August 2026, so the counterfactual rotation at 2026-09-30 is unambiguously larger; rationale updated accordingly.
